I am in Iringa, in the Southern Highlands. The rains here are good and the soil is not bad, so maize can give a fair harvest if I manage well. But this plot is rented and only 0.55 ha, so I must be careful with money — I cannot spend too much on fertilizer when the land is not mine. I will buy a small bag of DAP for planting and maybe a little urea for topdressing if I have money, use improved seed because everyone around here sees it yields better, and rely mostly on my own hands and my family for the weeding.
